what: The declared finer-resolution walk instrument: the state space 1296 ordered types with the boundary mark's row and column excluded on both sides and the same six relabeling-invariant summaries, with the real's own kept-adjacent pair sequence walked by one declared boundary head at the declared finer steps j / 1000 inside the three gaps the boundary-walk instrument located its flips in (ZL j 470 to 480, GC j 430 to 440, IT j 480 to 490), the two window-mass spans beside the head priced fresh at every finer position, the direction tables recorded at every finer position, no bands and no envelopes. The declared truthful questions: at which finer declared position each tracked direction flip turns - the tracked flips exactly the frozen boundary-walk direction records that change across each gap, computed mechanically - or whether any of them splits into more than one turn or drifts smoothly inside its gap. No mapping is published; nothing here is a reading.

declared.boundary_rule: the word-boundary mark's row and column are excluded from every profile's state space on both sides exactly as the boundary-mark re-instrument and the standing walk instruments declared: every profile is the mark-excluded block of its pair-count matrix, 1296 ordered types, and the standing alphabet-width disclosure carries unchanged (the IT real transcription ranks only 23 glyph types plus the mark, so 13 of its block's 36 glyph slots are empty by width alone on the real side)
declared.walk_rule: the window mass fixed at the standing basis arithmetic's first boundary - the int(quarter x the anchor basis) positions with the anchor basis the kept pair total + 1, so the window mass is ZL 54,604, GC 45,800 and IT 55,133 kept-adjacent pairs - and the head walked at int(step x the anchor basis) positions for the declared steps j / 1000 with j running over the three declared gaps exactly as the boundary-walk instrument located them: ZL j 470 to 480 inclusive, GC j 430 to 440 inclusive, IT j 480 to 490 inclusive, 11 heads per file, the first and last heads of each gap exactly the boundary-walk instrument's recorded heads at that gap's two hundredth steps; at every finer head the two spans beside the head are the window-mass span ending at the head and the window-mass span starting at the head, each priced fresh, no pair dropped, no pair synthesized
declared.tracked_rule: the tracked flips are exactly the side and summary direction records the frozen boundary-walk artifact records as changing across each gap's two hundredth steps, computed mechanically from the frozen stored directions and listed in the artifact, no hand selection performed over them, and the fine walk's direction tables are recorded at every finer head so each tracked flip's finer location is read off the recorded entries
declared.summary_rule: each profile is priced fresh through the same mark-excluded block and the same six relabeling-invariant summaries the standing instruments declare; no profile is compared to any simulated profile anywhere in this artifact
declared.no_band_rule: no rung band is loaded, no envelope is formed, no verdict and no scalar margin is produced anywhere in this artifact: the declared question is answered by direction, and the frozen rung bands stay the frozen instruments' declared records, untouched here
declared.direction_rule: each span records, for each of the six scalar summaries it shares with the whole profile (the empty type count, the self-pair share, the top-k shares at k 1, 10 and 50, and the pair entropy), whether its value sits above, below or equal to the whole sequence's value at the stored 6-decimal rounding, every entry recorded and no selection performed over anything
declared.roster_rule: the corpus-breadth roster stands unchanged: the same eight accepted corpus files, the same rejected candidates with their verbatim causes, the same sha256 records, the roster floor and the fetch verification are the corpus-breadth artifact's declared facts taken by reference, no corpus file is re-fetched, re-probed or re-hashed here, and no encoding is re-run anywhere: this instrument prices the real's own side only
declared.state_note: the real's kept-adjacency is real adjacency with 126 unmapped events inside ZL's 218,663, 1,769 inside GC's 186,708, none inside IT's 220,532, exactly as disclosed since the interior instrument; the real's side is identical for both languages of a file, so every cell prices the same fine-walk records; the whole-sequence profile is anchored to the frozen real-at-basis ladder's anchor profile in the gate
declared.machinery_rule: this instrument contains no assignment search anywhere: no candidate evaluation, no restarts, no sweep cap, no convergence flags, and no seed of any kind: the finer heads are the declared arithmetic and every profile is priced fresh from the real's own pair sequence, so the standing budgets and the seed-kind registry play no part here
declared.split_rule: no split applies: a profile uses every counted pair of its declared window after the declared exclusion; the climb and score halves of the band instruments have no counterpart here
declared.record_rule: per cell the artifact records the kept pair total, the window mass, the declared gap's steps, the whole-sequence profile with its boundary-carried pairs, the mechanical tracked-flip list, and the 11 head records in order, each carrying its declared step, its head position, and its two spans, each span carrying its first and end positions, its window mass, its own boundary-carried pairs, its fresh profile (the block total, both vector summaries as counts and shares, the empty type count, the self-pair share, the top-k shares and the pair entropy) and its direction record against the whole profile's six scalar summaries, every entry recorded
declared.closure_rule: no scalar margin is formed: this instrument's question is the direction run at every declared finer head per span, and the record answers it entry by entry
declared.exclusion_rule: the family's declared exclusion format is not re-scoped by this artifact: it keys to the declared 36-slot class under the inherited add-one form exactly as the held-out screen declared it, so a search-free verdict is structure evidence and the band instruments' verdicts stand untouched by this artifact's numbers
declared.gate_rule: before any span at any declared finer head is recorded beyond the gate, the gate verified fresh per cell: the whole profile against the frozen real-at-basis ladder's anchor profile, the fresh window mass against the frozen boundary-walk record, the 11 heads against the declared rule, the two window sizes at every head, the four endpoint span profiles against the frozen boundary-walk instrument's stored profiles at the gap's two hundredth steps, the two endpoint head positions against the frozen stored head positions, and the whole's own identity, 42 fields per cell, 252 fields all told; any divergence aborts with nothing written
declared.confluence_rule: the fine walk's endpoints are the boundary-walk instrument's frozen head records taken by reference and verified field for field in the gate: each gap's first head is that instrument's recorded lower hundredth head and each gap's last head its recorded upper hundredth head, so the fine walk begins and ends inside the boundary-walk instrument's declared records and its heads are declared arithmetic in between
declared.models_rule: no score table is built or used: the instrument prices count structure only, so the standing add-one and leave-one-out tables play no part anywhere in this artifact
